# Recipe: Save Email Attachments

💳 Curated by Skill Harbor — a gws recipe: search Gmail for messages with attachments (e.g. `has:attachment from:client@example.com`), download the attachments, and upload them into a chosen Google Drive folder — the manual download-then-upload loop done by the agent. Composes two utility skills (gws-gmail + gws-drive), which must be loaded first. Requires the gws CLI and a paid Google Workspace account — there is no free tier for this CLI. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: attachments land in your Drive — watch your storage quota on large batches; gws-shared must be read first for auth and global flags. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
